description: Replaces the plain-text maintainer notes of a question bank (never shown to participants) - the previous notes are overwritten entirely, not appended to, so read them with question_bank_get first and send everything that should remain. Notes are metadata rather than DRAFT content: the change takes effect immediately AND permanently, is unaffected by publishing or discarding and never counts as an unpublished change. Rejected for a public template id. Needs full access: riddle://reference/concepts/access.

notes.description: Plain-text notes for this bank, e.g. sourcing/curation instructions - replaces any existing notes entirely.

questionBankId.description: The ID of the question bank to annotate.

name: question_bank_update_notes
